meta.title: Privacy policy | Hormonexperten
meta.description: How Hormonexperten handles your data when you visit this website, and your rights.

pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.intro: This page explains which data is processed when you visit this website, why, and what rights you have.

sections.title: In brief

list: It loads no content, fonts or scripts from third parties. Even the font comes from our own server.
There are no forms and no user accounts on the website.
You book appointments in an external booking system, which opens only when you click a booking link.

sections.check_note: Only true once the colour palette tester in the header (stores the choice in localStorage) is removed before launch.

sections.title: Controller
body: The controller for data processing on this website under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:

lines: TODO: name of the practice or company

sections.title: Data protection officer
body: TODO: contact details of the data protection officer, or remove this section if none has to be appointed.

sections.title: Hosting and server log files
body: This website is hosted by TODO: name and location of the hosting provider. Each time a page is requested, the server automatically processes data that your browser sends:

list: date and time of the request
the page requested and the amount of data transferred
the page you came from (referrer), if your browser sends it
browser type, browser version and operating system

body: This data is technically necessary to deliver the website and keep it secure and stable. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; our legitimate interest is running the website securely and without errors. A data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR is in place with the hosting provider. Log files are deleted after TODO: number of days.
sections.check_note: Confirm the data processing agreement with the host; add where the data is stored (EU?).

sections.title: Encryption
body: The connection to this website is encrypted with TLS. You can tell by the “https://” in your browser’s address bar.

sections.title: Contacting us by email or phone
body: If you contact us by email or phone, we process your details to answer your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR if your enquiry concerns or prepares a treatment, otherwise Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. We process health information under Art. 9(2)(h) GDPR. We delete your enquiry once it has been dealt with, unless statutory retention periods apply.
Emails are usually not end-to-end encrypted. Please don’t send us detailed health information by email.
sections.check_note: Agree the advice on health information by email with the practice.

sections.title: Booking and payment
body: We use the practice management system Pabau (TODO: provider and address) for booking and payment. The booking page opens only when you click a booking link; no data is sent to Pabau before then. Pabau processes your data on our behalf under Art. 28 GDPR.

sections.check_note: Check the Pabau contract, server location and payment provider.

sections.title: Data from your treatment
body: This website does not collect data that arises during treatment, for example in video consultations or test results. We inform you about that separately in our patient privacy notice (TODO: link).

sections.title: Visitor statistics with Matomo
body: We measure how this website is used with Matomo, running on TODO: server or provider. Matomo sets no cookies and stores nothing on your device. IP addresses are shortened before they are stored, so we cannot identify you. The data is not passed on to third parties and is deleted after TODO: retention period.
The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; our legitimate interest is improving the website.
sections.check_note: Show only once Matomo is live; confirm the cookieless setup, IP shortening and retention period.

sections.title: Links to other websites
body: Links to social networks and other websites are plain links with no embedded content. Only when you click one do you leave our website; the other provider’s privacy policy then applies.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right

list: to access the data we hold about you (Art. 15 GDPR),
to have incorrect data corrected (Art. 16 GDPR),
to have your data erased (Art. 17 GDPR),
to withdraw consent at any time, with effect for the future (Art. 7(3) GDPR).

body: Where we process data under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, you can object at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation (Art. 21 GDPR).

sections.title: Right to complain
body: You can complain to a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR), in particular in the EU country where you live or work. The authority responsible for us is TODO: supervisory authority where the practice is based, with address.

sections.title: Changes
body: We update this privacy policy when the website or the law changes. The version published here applies.

pages.intro: This website sets no cookies and embeds no third-party content. That’s why there is no cookie banner and nothing to set here.

sections.title: What is stored on your device
body: Nothing that would need your consent. There are no advertising, tracking or social media cookies, and no videos, maps, fonts or review widgets that send data to third parties when the page loads.

body: If we ever add services that need your consent, we will ask you first. You will then be able to change your choice on this page at any time.
